results.title: Rave Victoria, the next showbiz heartthrob to watch for
results.description: Fans and viewers couldn't help but gush over the current crop of male housemates in 'Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition 2.0.' Grabbing the attention of many is Rave Victoria, who earned the moniker of 'Optimistic Apo ng Tarlac.' Rave has the potential to become one of the fast-rising heartthrobs in showbusiness with his boy-next-door looks and great physique. Check out some of the dashing photos of Rave Victoria in this gallery.
